user.title: Choose your school district
user.description: Select your district by name and location. {directory_status}

reauth_confirm.title: Update account password
reauth_confirm.description: The district API rejected authentication. Enter the current password for this account.

manual.title: Manual district setup
manual.description: Enter the HTTPS district API URL and district GUID, along with your credentials. Confirm the district timezone.

credentials.title: Connect to {district}
credentials.description: Enter your district account credentials for {district}. Confirm the district timezone; it defaults to your Home Assistant timezone. Student devices and bus locations will appear in Home Assistant.

error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Verify your district account credentials.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the district API.
error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTPS API URL without embedded credentials, query, or fragment.
error.invalid_timezone: Enter an IANA timezone, such as America/Detroit.
error.unsupported_password: This initial integration supports ASCII passwords only.
error.tls_error: Home Assistant could not validate the district HTTPS certificate or complete the TLS handshake. Check the HA clock and certificate trust; certificate verification remains enabled.
error.timeout: The district API did not respond within 30 seconds from Home Assistant.
error.dns_error: Home Assistant could not resolve the district hostname. Check DNS on the HA host.
error.connection_error: Home Assistant could not connect to or read from the district server. Check network access from HA.
error.invalid_response: The server returned an unexpected response instead of the expected API data. Check that the URL ends in /MyStopWebAPI/.
error.endpoint_not_found: The login endpoint returned HTTP 404. Check that the URL ends in /MyStopWebAPI/ (Lake Orion uses mystop.lok12.org/MyStopWebAPI/).
error.redirect_error: The API returned a redirect. Verify the API URL; credentials were not forwarded.
error.rate_limited: The district API is rate-limiting requests (HTTP 429). Wait before retrying.
error.server_error: The district API returned an HTTP 5xx server error. The exact status is in the Home Assistant log.
error.http_error: The district API returned an unexpected HTTP status. See the Home Assistant log for the status code.
error.invalid_district: Choose a district from the list.
error.district_http_only: This directory entry provides only HTTP. Use Manual setup with a district-confirmed HTTPS API URL and GUID.

init.title: Bus tracking options
init.description: Stale locations are last-known bus positions. The tracker retains a gps_status attribute; require fresh for location-based automations.

data.show_stale: Keep stale positions visible on the map

state.outside_window: Waiting for the next stop window

state.weekdays_assumed: No service days listed, assuming weekdays
